decisions.statement: The absorb/preserve axis is mechanical (cascade and session coupling), not semantic (capability vs destination)
decisions.support: Built SISOCRM estate: Teable and Postiz are both capabilities and got opposite treatments. Estate's own recorded reason is THEMING-CONTRACT.md:94-102 — custom properties do not inherit across a cross-origin iframe. Mechanical rule predicts 5/5 observed treatments; semantic rule 3/5 with 1 indeterminate.
decisions.falsifier: A donor requiring neither coupling absorbed natively for a reason other than brand exposure, or one requiring cascade inheritance shipped framed and themed correctly

decisions.statement: The full mount profile is (coupling, brand_exposure); the mechanical axis alone does not settle chrome treatment
decisions.support: AFFiNE and Postiz have identical coupling answers and different chrome treatment; AFFiNE renders no header at all while Postiz names the donor
decisions.falsifier: A donor set where coupling alone predicts chrome treatment without a separate brand input
decisions.note: Recorded as a second axis rather than forced through the first — the Sprint 1 failure was making one axis explain everything

decisions.statement: The coupling gates are also the cost estimate: they select a cost band an order of magnitude apart
decisions.support: Measured patch surface — preserved_framed 17-62 lines; absorbed_native 273 lines / 9 files touching auth strategy, SSR hop, DB provider and public API schema. Estate strategy doc: 'Not a weekend each.'
decisions.falsifier: A second estate where absorbed and preserved donors cost within 2x of each other
decisions.consequence: A07 ('adaptation is 1-2% of the work') is FALSE as a universal and roughly true for iframe-preserved donors only

decisions.statement: The host authors every rail entry; donors declare intent, never position
decisions.support: Unanimous in the built estate — GroupedRail.tsx:43-65 is one literal array, no donor contributes a row. WordPress $position collision is the counter-example.
decisions.falsifier: An estate adopting a donor-authored rail row with no second-silo effect

decisions.statement: A destination budget that is not machine-checked is not a budget
decisions.support: The same estate that wrote 'The broker never clicks Tables' shipped Tables as a rail destination (GroupedRail.tsx:56), and grew 11 planned destinations to 13. Rail entries are added by drift, not by decision.
decisions.falsifier: A destination cap held across a full build with no machine check

decisions.statement: Five areas is a budget cap, not a schema; geometry is pixels with a collapse rule, never a ratio
decisions.support: Five-tuple falsified at semantic level in ISSO source; built estate independently chose 4 groups / 13 destinations. No surveyed product implements a rail as a percentage; only proportional rule found is VS Code min(300px, viewport/4).
decisions.falsifier: Practitioners score a five-slot nav within noise of a spine-derived nav on first-click accuracy (E1, unrun)

decisions.statement: Tenant switching is the one L0 surface with no built implementation, and a donor's chrome is covering for it
decisions.support: No host switcher UI found; workspaceId threaded at App.tsx:200; Teable's space switcher deliberately left visible because the host had none
decisions.falsifier: A host tenant switcher exists in the estate at a path this lane did not read
decisions.note: Shape of an INV-S3 violation waiting to happen; first thing a pilot must close

decisions.statement: Rights gate (G0) runs before any chrome work
decisions.support: NocoBase §5.2 forbids removing brand/name/link/version from the interface; Directus MSCL forbids circumventing the licence key. 28/104 repos returned NOASSERTION and reading bodies moved verdicts in both directions.
decisions.falsifier: A donor set where no licence constrains chrome removal
